title: Verification Behavior Across Five Qwen2.5-Instruct Checkpoints
abstract: arXiv:2611.25745v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We evaluate five Qwen2.5-Instruct checkpoints (0.5B to 32B) under four prompting conditions using three fixed tasks per information condition and five generations per task. Two AI raters scored 600 trajectories. Under the coordinated instruction, both raters recorded strict declarations of insufficiency in 11/15 cases at 7B, 0/15 at 14B, and 5/15 at 32B. The runner sent a standard follow-up when a request detector fired. The three checkpoints received at least one follow-up in 15, 12, and 15 cases, respectively. On information-sufficient tasks at 3B through 32B, scored format markers appeared in 60/60 protocol trajectories and 0/60 baseline trajectories. After adjudication, 1/60 in each condition met the diagnostic-execution criterion (H3). Across all checkpoints and prompts, 7/300 information-sufficient trajectories met H3 after adjudication, all on the same task. The prespecified upward transition did not occur in this run. translated_title: 跨越五个Qwen2.5-Instruct检查点的验证行为
translated_abstract: 我们在四种提示条件下评估了五个Qwen2.5-Instruct检查点（0.5B至32B），每个信息条件使用三个固定任务，每个任务生成五次，两名AI评分员对600条轨迹进行了评分。在协调指令下，两位评分员记录的严格不充分声明在7B时为11/15例，14B时为0/15例，32B时为5/15例。当请求检测器触发时，运行程序发送了标准后续请求，三个检查点分别在其中15、12和15个案例中收到至少一次后续请求。在3B至32B的信息充足任务上，协议轨迹中出现了60/60的评分格式标记，而基线轨迹中为0/60。经过裁决后，每种条件下各有1/60满足诊断执行标准（H3）。在所有检查点和提示中，300条信息充足轨迹中有7条在裁决后满足H3，且全部集中在同一任务上。本次运行中未出现预先设定的向上转变。
tldr: 本研究通过双AI评分员协议系统评估了五个Qwen2.5-Instruct检查点对信息不充分的声明与验证行为，发现协议提示能可靠引发格式标记（60/60），但诊断执行标准（H3）极少被满足，且预期的随模型规模增长的向上转变并未出现。
en_tdlr: This study systematically evaluates verification and insufficiency-declaration behaviors across five Qwen2.5-Instruct checkpoints, showing that protocol prompts reliably elicit format markers (60/60), but the diagnostic-execution criterion (H3) is rarely met and the prespecified upward transition with model scale does not occur.
